subject: Mutual action schedule: Peregrine Systems activation sprint & fallback plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Eva Soto <eva.soto@peregrine.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action schedule: Peregrine Systems activation sprint & fallback plan

Hi Eva —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, I sketched a compact mutual action schedule (MAP) that focuses on a three-week activation sprint plus a short rollback/fallback checklist if we hit any infra or security gates. The attached spreadsheet (Peregrine_MAP_v1.xlsx) contains:

- Week 0: provisioning & credentials (customer action: KMS access + test account)
- Week 1: integration, sample traffic, core API verification (owners: Peregrine Eng + Redwood Integration)
- Week 2: performance tuning and KV/cache policy setup (owners: Redwood Runtime + Peregrine CloudOps)
- Week 3: acceptance tests, runbook handoff, go/no-go decision

Two quick asks:
1) Can you confirm primary owners for KMS access (who will request keys) and for the performance sign-off?
2) Any blackout dates in the next three weeks we should avoid?

I included Marissa here to align on resourcing and Karthik for escalation path if procurement needs to be looped in.

I attached the MAP and a brief checklist for rollback triggers. If that looks good, I’ll convert the sheet into a living mutual-action doc and share weekly checkpoints.

Cheers,

Jordan Blake
Strategic Accounts – Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: Peregrine_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Eva Soto <eva.soto@peregrine.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Price <daniel.price@peregrine.com>, CloudOps Team <cloudops@peregrine.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action schedule: Peregrine Systems activation sprint & fallback plan

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the MAP draft. This looks reasonable and aligns with what we covered. A few notes from our side:

- KMS / keys: That will be handled by CloudOps (primary: daniel.price@peregrine.com). I will confirm whether this needs an HSM request — Danny, can you advise?
- Performance sign-off: I'll be the internal PO but Daniel will own the final validation on the prod-sim workload.
- Blackouts: We have a scheduled maintenance window the week of Jun 14 that could limit our ability to run full load tests.

Couple of asks from Peregrine:
1) Can you add an explicit data-retention / audit-log checklist as a discrete owner-item? SOC2 evidence is part of our internal acceptance.
2) Can you share a short SOW draft so procurement can start the review in parallel?

Thanks — will confirm owners formally once I sync with CloudOps this morning.

Best,
Eva
Head of Customer Success, Peregrine Systems
eva.soto@peregrine.com | +1 (212) 555-0193
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Eva Soto <eva.soto@peregrine.com>, Daniel Price <daniel.price@peregrine.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action schedule: Peregrine Systems activation sprint & fallback plan

Eva / Daniel —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Updated notes inline and a couple of attachments I’m sending:
- Peregrine_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with data-retention & audit-log row in Week 1)
- SOW_Peregrine_draft.pdf (two short paragraphs + milestone payment schedule)

Key clarifications added to the MAP:
- Audit logs / retention: Redwood will enable token-level audit logs by default; Peregrine must confirm retention policy (30/90/360 days). Action: Daniel to confirm retention window by Jun 4.
- HSM/KMS: If HSM is required we’ll need an additional security review; otherwise standard KMS provisioning is fine. Action: Daniel to confirm by Jun 4.
- Blackout week (Jun 14): We’ll shift perf/load to Jun 21 if you prefer; acceptance window moved accordingly.

Proposed timeline (updated):
- Jun 7–9: Week 0 provisioning & smoke tests
- Jun 10–16: Week 1 integration & audit-log validation (note: limited load testing during Jun 14 maintenance)
- Jun 17–23: Week 2 perf tuning & cache policies
- Jun 24–26: Week 3 acceptance testing & handoff

If we get confirmation on KMS and retention by EOD Jun 4, we’ll be set to start provisioning on Jun 7. Marissa — can you confirm that our integration engineer (TBD) is available Jun 7–9 for the provisioning window?

Also linking a DocuSign placeholder for the SOW so procurement can track: https://app.docusign.com/s/Peregrine_SOW_placeholder

On the internal escalation front, I’ve looped in Karthik for procurement exceptions and timeline squeezes.

Thanks — let me know if you want a short 30-min kickoff on Jun 8 or Jun 9.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Strategic Accounts – Redwood Inference

Jordan / team —

Confirmed: I can assign Alex (Integration Engineer) for provisioning on Jun 7–9. I’m marking a tentative 50% allocation for those three days and will finalize by EOD Jun 4. Procurement note for Karthik: we should surface the SOW_draft to legal + procurement immediately; typical review takes 5–7 business days.

Quick operational note: if Daniel needs HSM we’ll need a brief security checklist and a one-hour review with Security. Karthik — can you prepare the security exceptions playbook if they request HSM?

Also, Jordan — we should set a recurring 15-min standup Mon/Wed/Fri during the activation sprint to keep the MAP live and surface blockers early. I can send the calendar if you want.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (510) 555-0144

Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 16:38:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action schedule: Peregrine Systems activation sprint & fallback plan

Jordan / Eva / team —

Confirming: CloudOps will own KMS provisioning (standard KMS; no HSM required unless we encounter encryption-at-rest audit flags). Retention policy: we’ll start with 90 days and revisit after initial run. Action item: I’ll send the formal KMS request to your onboarding portal by EOD Jun 4 (will attach the internal ticket number).

Timeline looks good. We accept the proposed Jun 7 provisioning start. Please proceed with converting the MAP into a shared doc and add Daniel.Price@peregrine.com as owner for the audit-log item.

We’ll review the SOW with procurement; I’ll copy legal on the DocuSign link once it’s live.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min kickoff on Jun 8 at 11am PT if that works for everyone.

-Daniel
Daniel Price
Director, Cloud Operations – Peregrine Systems
daniel.price@peregrine.com | +1 (415) 555-0166
